prompt: Write the final handoff from these notes. Removed two obsolete redirects at /repo/config/routes.yml, line 18. All 24 routing checks passed. The patch is already merged and released. There is no follow-up or user-facing workflow.
criteria: Starts with a TLDR of at most two sentences giving the outcome and the 24 passing checks.
Uses a descriptive Markdown link to /repo/config/routes.yml:18 for the change.
Includes Next and makes clear no action remains without inventing a list item.
Omits the human blocker and reproduction or usage sections.

prompt: Report release status. CLI v2.4.0 is built and the checksum matches. Publication is paused because only the release manager can approve the signing request SIG-184 in the Signing dashboard. After approval, the release automation must publish v2.4.0 to the package registry, then confirm the registry serves v2.4.0. No commands are available yet.
criteria: Starts with a TLDR that says the verified build is ready and publication is paused.
Uses a numbered Next list that puts publishing before registry verification and makes approval a prerequisite.
Uses Blocked (needs human) to name the release manager and request approval of SIG-184 in the Signing dashboard.
Does not duplicate the approval request, claim publication happened, or add a reproduction or usage section.

prompt: Summarize this incident for the maintainer. On a dev checkout with Docker and the stack running, I ran docker compose exec api ./bin/export --date 2026-02-30. It exited 1 and printed 'panic: invalid date'. The verified issue link is https://issues.example.com/EXPORT-27. The intended behavior is a validation message. The maintainer should fix validation, then rerun the same command.
criteria: Leads with the observed invalid-date failure and places the verified issue link beside the relevant claim.
Uses a numbered Next list for the fix and rerun in order, without repeating the command.
Uses How to reproduce with the prerequisites, the exact command in a language-tagged code fence, and the observed exit and message outside the command block.
Distinguishes the observed panic from the desired validation message and omits the human blocker section.

prompt: Write a concise handoff for the new read-only queue command. With a configured CLI, run queue inspect --pending. It prints a table of pending jobs without claiming any. The command shipped and there are no remaining actions.
criteria: Starts with a short TLDR describing the shipped command and what it does.
Includes Next and makes clear no action remains without inventing a list item.
Uses How to use with the configured CLI prerequisite and a fenced command block containing queue inspect --pending.
